from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/src/matio/src/mat.c')
text = p.read_text()
# Patch 1: in MAT_C_STRUCT block, change nf calculation
old_line = 'size_t nf = (matvar->internal != NULL) ? matvar->internal->num_fields : 0;'
idx = text.find(old_line)
print('Found old nf pattern at index', idx)
if idx != -1:
    # Build new nf block
    new_nf_block = '''size_t nf = 0;
                    if ( matvar->internal != NULL ) {
                        nf = matvar->internal->num_fields;
                    }'''
    text = text.replace(old_line, new_nf_block)
else:
    print('Could not find exact nf line to patch')
# Patch 2: modify for loop to NULL-check
# We'll replace the next two lines after the line containing 'for ( i = 0; i < nelems_x_nfields; i++ )' with a block including braces and NULL check
lines = text.splitlines(True)
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'for ( i = 0; i < nelems_x_nfields; i++ )' in line:
        # ensure we haven't already patched: check next non-space line
        # We'll insert braces and NULL check across following lines
        # Replace the for line with the opening brace line if not already present
        lines[i] = '                    for ( i = 0; i < nelems_x_nfields; i++ ) {\n'
        # Replace the next line (the Mat_VarFree call) with NULL-check block
        if i+1 < len(lines):
            lines[i+1] = '                        if (fields[i] != NULL) {\n'
            lines.insert(i+2, '                            Mat_VarFree(fields[i]);\n')
            lines.insert(i+3, '                            fields[i] = NULL;\n')
            lines.insert(i+4, '                        }\n')
            lines.insert(i+5, '                    }\n')
        break
text = ''.join(lines)
p.write_text(text)
print('Patched mat.c')
